recommendations: Add root-series version, citation, supported conformance claims, and typed dataset relationships without promoting child metadata into the parent.
Document biological payload formats, applicable encodings, variable dictionaries, tabular status, and explicit subset roles.
Describe raw-source lineage, transformations, processing software, annotation quality, and missing-data or imputation practices.
Document applicable oversight outcomes, the basis for deidentification, and privacy or consent statuses without inventing exemptions or human participation.
Add substantive change history and data-quality findings, and clarify public package contents versus embargoed streams.
Define concrete supported research tasks with inputs, targets, and intended analyses.

consistency_check_details.description: The named NIH Bridge2AI funding and functional-genomics purposes are mutually consistent.
Root and release licenses consistently specify CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, and separate commercial negotiation is compatible with the stated noncommercial restriction.
The root description, version_access latest DOI, and June 2026 child resource identify the same current release.
The non-human-subject designation is internally plausible for the described commercially available de-identified cell-line material; this does not establish an applicability exclusion.
Project-wide counts and differing release-level protein counts are explicitly qualified rather than presented as interchangeable totals.
The deidentification claim lacks the specific method or verification procedure expected by the registered consistency rule.
Public ZIP access and embargo statements can coexist, but the record does not fully explain their relationship for underlying data availability.

correctness_validations.doi_format: Listed release and publication DOIs have plausible DOI syntax and prefixes. The root doi field is absent. DOI resolution and registration were not externally checked.
correctness_validations.grant_number_format: The three supplied NIH award identifiers have plausible NIH structure, including application type, activity code, institute, serial number, and year or supplement suffix.
correctness_validations.rrid_format: The root identifier is a URI. RRID:CVCL_B5P3 and RRID:CVCL_0419 occur as cell-line identifiers in subset prose; they fall outside the instrument's specified SCR_/AB_ patterns and are not credited as dataset RRIDs. This pattern limitation does not establish that the cell-line identifiers are invalid.
correctness_validations.temporal_consistency: Later file issue dates can represent revisions after initial release publication. The June 2026 release-date disagreement is explicitly attributed and resolved within the record in favor of the Dataverse value; no external verification was performed.
correctness_validations.url_validity: Supplied HTTPS URLs have plausible structure and domains. Reachability and destination contents were not checked.
